findings.current: “So he couldn’t block it completely even with Body-Protecting Qi.”
findings.defect: The omitted subject is the Western Heaven Demon Lord himself, but the draft changes it to a third-person subject.
findings.rationale: He is reflecting on his own failure to block Taekyung’s attack, as confirmed by the immediately following description of Taekyung piercing his defense and wounding him.
findings.replacement: “To think I couldn’t completely block it even with Body-Protecting Qi.”

findings.current: Jin Taekyung had pierced through his Body-Protecting Qi with nothing more than flesh and fabric and wounded him.
findings.defect: The draft adds “flesh”; 피륙 means cloth or fabric. This changes the stated mechanism of the extraordinary attack.
findings.rationale: The source specifically emphasizes that mere fabric penetrated the defensive qi.
findings.replacement: Jin Taekyung had pierced his Body-Protecting Qi with a mere scrap of cloth and wounded him.
findings.source: 진태경은 한낱 피륙으로 호신강기를 뚫고 자신에게 상처를 입혔다.

findings.current: With an ordinary face and build, he would have looked like any middle-aged man one might encounter anywhere if not for his Jang Sam, which was torn and stained entirely with blood.
findings.defect: 장삼 is an ordinary long robe in this context, not the personal name Jang Sam. The capitalization and unexplained romanization misidentify the garment.
findings.rationale: The sentence contrasts his commonplace appearance with his blood-soaked clothing.
findings.replacement: With his ordinary face and build, he would have looked like any unremarkable middle-aged man if not for his long robe, torn to shreds and soaked in blood.
findings.source: 온통 찢어지고 피로 물든 장삼이 아니었다면 그는 어디서나 볼 수 있는 흔한 중년인이었다.

findings.current: The art of Seizing an Object Through Empty Space—a technique visible only to someone who possessed terrifying internal energy.
findings.defect: The draft makes the technique perceptible only to a powerful observer, whereas the source says only a person with formidable internal energy can perform or display it.
findings.rationale: 보일 수 있는 describes the practitioner’s ability to demonstrate the feat, not an observer’s ability to see it.
findings.replacement: The art of Seizing an Object Through Empty Space—a feat only someone with terrifying internal energy could perform.
findings.source: 가공할 공력의 소유자만이 보일 수 있는 허공섭물(虛空攝物)의 기예.

findings.current: The Divine Physician flew as though he had been thrown against something. When his neck was caught in the Western Heaven Demon Lord’s hand, his face turned deathly pale.
findings.defect: The draft says he was thrown against an object, introducing a collision absent from the source. He is propelled through the air as though struck or repelled, then caught by the throat.
findings.rationale: 퉁겨지듯 describes the manner in which he is sent flying, not his being thrown into another object.
findings.replacement: Flung through the air as though something had struck him, the Divine Physician turned deathly pale as the Western Heaven Demon Lord caught him by the throat.
findings.source: 무언가에 퉁겨지듯 날아가, 서천마군의 손아귀에 목이 잡힌 신의의 안색이 창백하게 질렸다.

findings.current: “That does not seem like something a physician who just used an assassin’s technique should say. Come to think of it, does that make you a fiend as well?”
findings.defect: “An assassin’s technique” treats 살수 as a professional style rather than the lethal move the physician has just unleashed.
findings.rationale: In context, the accusation concerns the physician’s readiness to use lethal force, creating the Western Heaven Demon Lord’s hypocritical joke.
findings.replacement: “That hardly seems like something a physician who unleashed a killing move without hesitation should say. Wait, wouldn’t that make you a fiend too?”
findings.source: “거리낌 없이 살수(殺手)를 펼친 의원이 할 말은 아닌 듯싶은데. 가만있자, 그럼 자네 역시 악귀가 아닌가?”

findings.defect: “Crack” suggests something breaking, but 턱 marks the palm strike being abruptly caught or blocked; the hand is broken only in the following beat.
findings.rationale: The source separates the blocked strike from the subsequent 우두둑 of the physician’s hand being broken.

findings.current: “The Family Head was right. You had it.”
findings.defect: The draft omits 당, losing the explicit identification of the Tang Family Head.
findings.rationale: The source names which Family Head supplied the information.
findings.replacement: “The Tang Family Head was right. You had it.”
findings.source: “당 가주가 한 말이 맞았군. 그대가 갖고 있었어.”

findings.current: I simply continued toward the one person who was waiting somewhere beyond it.
findings.defect: “Was waiting” adds an intentional action absent from the source.
findings.rationale: The Korean says only that the person would be beyond the darkness, not that the person was consciously waiting.
findings.replacement: I simply continued toward the one person somewhere beyond it.
findings.source: 그저 저 너머에 있을 한 사람을 향해 계속해서 나아갈 뿐이다.

findings.current: “It wasn’t free. I was given a favor to fulfill.”
findings.defect: “Given a favor” reverses the ordinary semantic roles and is unnatural English; Taekyung received a request.
findings.rationale: 부탁을 받다 means to be asked a favor or receive a request, clarified immediately afterward as the request to kill the Western Heaven Demon Lord.
findings.replacement: “It wasn’t free. I was asked to do one thing.”

summary: One critical subject reversal and several localized fidelity, mechanism, and wording issues.
